## Overview

This analysis combines directionality (sign concordance) results from multiple validation cohorts to assess whether CpG sites show consistent effect directions between AGES and external studies. Uses binomial tests to evaluate significance of concordance.

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| echo: false

# Additional packages (tidyverse, here, glue loaded via .Rprofile)
pacman::p_load(ggtext, ggh4x, scales, install = FALSE)

conflicted::conflict_prefer_all("dplyr", quiet = TRUE)
```

## Load and Combine Directionality Data

Load directionality results from individual validation analyses and combine into a single dataset.

```{r}
#| label: load-data

combined_data <- bind_rows(
  read_rds(here("validation/output/directionality_results_ADNI_AIBL.rds")) |>
    mutate(dataset = "ADNI/AIBL Meta-analysis"),
  read_rds(here("validation/output/directionality_results_CSF_pTau_CN.rds")) |>
    mutate(dataset = "CSF pTau (CN)"),
  read_rds(here("validation/output/directionality_results_CSF_total_Tau_CN.rds")) |>
    mutate(dataset = "CSF Total Tau (CN)")
)

glimpse(combined_data)
```

## Prepare Data for Faceted Plot

Filter to key dementia transitions and compute -log10 transformed P-values.

```{r}
#| label: prepare-data

# Filter to three key transitions and create metrics
three_transitions <- c("prev", "mci2incid", "normal2incid")

plot_data <- combined_data |>
  filter(demcat %in% three_transitions) |>
  mutate(
    demcat = fct_relevel(demcat, "normal2incid", "mci2incid", "prev"),
    neg_log10_binom_pval = -log10(binom_pval),
    dataset = factor(dataset, levels = c(
      "ADNI/AIBL Meta-analysis",
      "CSF Total Tau (CN)",
      "CSF pTau (CN)"
    ))
  )

glimpse(plot_data)
```

## Faceted Plot

This plot shows how the directionality concordance (binomial test P-value) changes across association P-value thresholds. Each facet represents a validation dataset, with lines colored by dementia transition.

The plot specification is defined once and reused for both the combined figure and the ADNI/AIBL-only figure, so the two cannot drift apart. `label_facet` names the facet that carries the *P* = 0.05 annotation.

```{r}
#| label: helper-build-plot

build_directionality_plot <- function(df, label_facet) {
  stopifnot(label_facet %in% levels(df$dataset))

  p_label_data <- tibble(
    dataset = factor(label_facet, levels = levels(df$dataset)),
    cutoff_value = 4.5,
    neg_log10_binom_pval = -log10(0.05)
  )

  ggplot(df, aes(x = cutoff_value, y = neg_log10_binom_pval, color = demcat)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
    geom_text(data = p_label_data, aes(x = cutoff_value, y = neg_log10_binom_pval),
              label = "italic(P) == 0.05", parse = TRUE, vjust = -0.5, hjust = 0,
              size = 3, color = "gray30") +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(size = 1.5) +
    facet_wrap(~ dataset, nrow = 1) +
    scale_x_reverse(breaks = c(4.5, 4, 3.5, 3, 2.5, 2)) +
    scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
    labs(
      x = "-log10(Association <i>P</i>-value) Threshold",
      y = "-log10(Binomial Test <i>P</i>-value)",
      color = "Dementia Transition"
    ) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
      strip.text = element_markdown(size = 11, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x = element_markdown(),
      axis.title.y = element_markdown(),
      panel.spacing = unit(0.8, "lines")
    )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-directionality-combined
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5

p <- build_directionality_plot(plot_data, label_facet = "CSF pTau (CN)")

print(p)
```

## ADNI/AIBL-Only Plot

The manuscript's main validation figure shows sign concordance for the ADNI/AIBL meta-analysis alone. This is built here rather than by subsetting the composed plot object downstream, so that a change in the upstream dataset labels fails loudly instead of silently producing a smaller figure. The combined plot above is retained unchanged — the presentation deck reads it.

```{r}
#| label: fig-directionality-adni-aibl
#| fig-width: 4
#| fig-height: 5

adni_dataset <- "ADNI/AIBL Meta-analysis"

plot_data_adni <- plot_data |>
  filter(dataset == adni_dataset) |>
  mutate(dataset = fct_drop(dataset))

stopifnot(
  nrow(plot_data_adni) > 0,
  setequal(levels(plot_data_adni$dataset), adni_dataset)
)

p_adni <- build_directionality_plot(plot_data_adni, label_facet = adni_dataset)

print(p_adni)
```

## Export Figures

Save the combined and ADNI/AIBL-only directionality figures as PNG and RDS files.

```{r}
#| label: save-figures

ggsave(
  here("validation/output/fig_directionality_combined.png"),
  p,
  width = 10,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white",
  device = ragg::agg_png
)
write_rds(p, here("validation/output/fig_directionality_combined.rds"))

ggsave(
  here("validation/output/fig_directionality_ADNI_AIBL_only.png"),
  p_adni,
  width = 4,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white",
  device = ragg::agg_png
)
write_rds(p_adni, here("validation/output/fig_directionality_ADNI_AIBL_only.rds"))

message("Figures saved to validation/output/")
```
